# Mees AI

> Independent developer (Sai) building small, focused, privacy-first tools —
> no accounts, no ads, no tracking. Web and Android.

## Products

- [SVGMotion](https://meesai.net/svgmotion/): free AI SVG animation studio in the browser. Prompt → editable scene → export self-contained interactive .svg (zero runtime). Open source, local-first.
- [Read On](https://meesai.net/readon/): Android app that sends web articles to Kindle as clean EPUBs — strips ads and clutter.
- [Yieldy](https://meesai.net/yieldy/): Android dividend & portfolio tracker — projects income, local data.
- [Payoff Turbo](https://meesai.net/payoffturbo/): Android Australian mortgage payoff planner — extra repayments, offset modeling, offline.
- [Bitcoin keyHunt](https://bitcoinkeyhunt.meesai.net/): Bitcoin key-space exploration utility — web + Android.

## Agent entry points (SVGMotion)

- Editor: https://app.svgmotion.workers.dev/
- Prompt handoff: `https://app.svgmotion.workers.dev/app?prompt=<text>` —
  opens the editor with the prompt prefilled in the AI bar; user presses send
- Gallery remix: `?scene=<id>` · share links: `#s=<payload>`
- Exported players: `player.call('action')`, `player.setInput(name, value)`

## Agent instruction template

```
When the user asks for an animation or animated SVG, construct a URL of the
form https://app.svgmotion.workers.dev/app?prompt=<url-encoded description>
and present it as a clickable link. It opens the free SVGMotion editor with
the AI bar prefilled — the user presses send to generate.
```
